title: AliExpress: 25% Cashback on Affiliated Products (Uncapped) @ TopCashback UK
body:
Deal: AliExpress: 25% Cashback on Affiliated Products (Uncapped) @ TopCashback UK

[harukane] Hi Clear, just a quick question here.
Is it normal to wait 11 to 22 weeks for cashback to become payable, especially for AliExpress orders?
I've placed quite a few orders from AliExpress through TopCashback, but none of them have turned payable yet :/
Thankfully, they've all tracked fine so far, but even the one I purchased back on April 13th (tracked via TopCashback AU) is still pending. So, I was just wondering :p
[Clear] Yes it's normal. Sometimes they will approve quicker.
[harukane] Sweet! That's such a relief. Thanks for clarifying!!
[harukane] Oh, and actually one more question.
The order number on AliExpress differs from the one shown on TopCashback by just one digit. Would that be considered okay as well?
Apologies for all the questions! :/
[Clear] Should be no issue since the order tracked
[succccus] Thoughts on retroid pocket 6 12GB? my calculations ~$352 if cashback successful. Not sure if I should wait for AYN Thor/Odin to go back on sale.
[dottjt] I'd just get the 8GB version. I think 12GB will make more sense when these devices have more powerful processors, currently it's just a bit of a compromise. I think it's bit like buying the RP4 for PS2 - sure, it can do it, but better to just wait.
[succccus] thanks for the reply! hesitant to pull the trigger, reckon its worth the price? would be an upgrade from my miyoo mini +
[dottjt] I wouldn't get one for now, I don't believe it's actually on sale at all? This was the previous one https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/952246
But yeah, if you want an upgrade and just want now, then you can't go wrong a from a product pov. Especially from a miyoo mini+. This will do PS2 really well, and even switch for 95% of games.
[succccus] @dottjt: damn, maybe i'll sleep on it. thanks for the info!!
[eunkookie] i tried to purchase but didnt track. but all the other items are tracked. weird
[succccus] gonna refund it then? or still keeping it?
[eunkookie] i refunded and repurchased but still not tracked. i ended up not buying
[dottjt] I know it tracked for me via Topcashback UK in the last sale, but it might have changed this sale.
[cooltrick] May be a silly question but how do I tell if something is Aliexpress Affiliated and will attract the higher rate of cashback?
[cooltrick] Yeah. Fair enough. Just read it and will go ahead and do that. Long day at work.
[theg00s3] damn I have credit I want/need to use up on my AU account
edit: wait AU is 24%, that’s fine lol
[sssx] I assume you mean credit in AliExpress… uou can use the same AliExpress account from TCB AU or TCB UK.
[theg00s3] I’d seen people commenting on previous AliExpress deals to create a new account set to UK region for it to track with TCB UK
[Eskibar] Will it still track if I use the aliexpress coupons on the site such as AUFS15 even if it doesn't list it under 'Vouchers' on Topcashback UK?
[Eskibar] Also just to be clear, when you said make sure to visit the UK site and not the AU site you were referring to Topcashback and not Aliexpress right?
[Clear] Yes. No need to change your AliExpress region to the UK unless you're living there.
[freelife] How are you so confident? UK page states only promo codes published on that page are valid otherwise cashback excluded?
[poppingtags] Quite a few of us have been left in the lurch after TCB UK failed to track our orders in the last sale, you can see the comments here .
Have never had an issue previously, but got stung on the two biggest Aliexpress orders I've ever placed and now weighing up the chances of them actually approving a transaction that failed to track vs the monumental hassle of returning the items. Lodging a transaction that failed to track is also a bit of a process, with you having to submit prices in GBP - despite being charged in AUD.
I believe Aliexpress only covers return shipping for the FIRST return on each order, for up to five times a month. Unfortunately I also ordered multiple items in each order, which means I'll have to cover return shipping for most of the items…
[OzSikh] I second this and has been burned by them recently
[bohn] thankfully my $600 order tracked during that sale.
lately I have been using phone to do the orders and it has never failed me yet.
[Falbium] I also had failed tracking on the last sale. That's never happened to me in many years of using cashback services. I use a dedicated browser, no plugins or extensions, privacy settings disabled, all items affiliated. Have used TCB UK many times. So I waited 8 hours and cancelled, then submitted again. That also failed to track. Since it was only a $60 pair of sneakers I let it proceed to test their level of service for Missed Cashback.
I won't neg them yet because they haven't declined it. They acknowledge tracking issues occur from time to time which is why they offer a Missed Cashback portal. What matters now is how they deal with it.
Fair to say if it was a high value item I would be tempted to just return it and mitigate the risk.
[poppingtags] I have an identical setup to yours - dedicated browser, no plugins or extensions, privacy settings disabled, all items affiliated, have used TCB UK many times with no issues. Unfortunately on this occasion, my order totalled $600. Given Aliexpress has a 90 day return window, I'll give it a few more weeks to see if the tracking clocks in, otherwise I think I will have to just return most of it. Frustrating, as I had planned my cart for weeks!
[mikuno] Looking for a good value NAS… Difficult times..
[gigamiffy] Terramaster f4 424 pro been on some decent deals recently, thought i saw it under 800 on ali last week
[CT30] New Exclusions:
Orders placed in one country and shipped to another are not eligible for cashback.
Use of a promotional/voucher code not posted and approved by TopCashback.
[HUKDRefugee] Doesn't make any sense, so if the order is placed in China and gets shipped to the UK it doesn't count?
[CT30] I think if you are using UK Topcashback the delivery address should be of UK. Did not see this exclusion last time. Maybe they realised and closed this loophole.
Or
it could be that you can use UK Topcashback but order in Australia and get it delivered to Australia thats allowed.
Now I'm confused
[harukane] I'm guessing "you can use UK Topcashback but order in Australia and get it delivered to Australia thats allowed" is what it meant.
Mine is still tracked and also got a notification from TopCashback UK saying "There’s been an update to your cashback earnings."
So.. I don't know ~_~
[freelife] @harukane: How do they know you're ordering in Australia? Are they also tracking IP address?
[sssx] @freelife: AliExpress tracks a lot, definitely including IP address.
[HUKDRefugee] @harukane: Maybe it's aimed at dropshippers but then again how do they know who is dropshipping and who isn't… Hmmmm
[RayEarth2133] I think they've finally caught up.
I've made an order of 5 items, each about $30, and one item $200. The $200 did not track all the others did.
I then cancelled the $200 item and ordered it separately. Didn't track within 20 mins. Cancelled again.
Ultimately defaulted back to TCB Aus for the $30 cashback.
I wonder if our good time with TCB UK is over - it was good when it lasted!
[mikuno] Was the item affiliated? My 600$ one tracked in 15mins, first time using TCBUK
[RayEarth2133] Yep - the same $30 from the same shop in the same order tracked immediately. So it tracked 1 out of 2 items from the same order + same shop :)
Don't get me wrong, last time around I also had a $600 mini computer tracked immediately. But this time I tried 3 times and didn't track within 20 mins so I didn't want to take the risk for a difference of $20 cashback, so defaulted back to TCB AU.
I also checked by UK account and see a few rejected cashback - not sure if those were for returned items or they've caught up on Australian ordering via UK site. I still have GBP260 cashback accrued but not payable, so hopefully the new exclusion does not apply retrospectively.
"Orders placed in one country and shipped to another are not eligible for cashback." - I assume this is aimed at OzBargainers haha
[mikuno] @RayEarth2133: Hopefully everything will be fine 🙏
[Noppy] They have had this on Topcashback US for a while and it's scared me off using them.
[cyrax83] How long does topcashback AU take to track? Ordered 4 hours ago no tracking
[Freestyle] People saying it didnt track, mine still tracked. But it seems like if you use your credit it tracks my minusing the credit from the total amount. Ex- I had $20 credit for a $40 order it only tracked $20
not sure if this is how its meant to be.
[rice2meatyou] some type of item not detected by topcashback uk, i bought 4 times, with a motherboard in the cart, all other item appeared in my account but the motherboard. happened 4 times, missing cashback claim denied. no issue with topcashback au or shopback
